name: Crooked Stride (Combat)
body:
Your erratic movement makes you a much harder target.

Prerequisite(s): Dodge, Mobility

Benefit(s): When you take an action to move at least 1/2 your speed, you may choose one square along your movement that you will not provoke attacks of opportunity for moving through.
